# API error codes

Every failed request returns the same JSON body (content type `application/problem+json`, RFC 9457):

```json
{
  "type": "https://api.dumbbill.in/errors/discount-exceeds-limit",
  "title": "Discount exceeds your limit",
  "status": 422,
  "code": "DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_LIMIT",
  "detail": "Maximum allowed is 5%.",
  "requestId": "01JA0000000000000000000000",
  "errors": [{ "field": "discount.value", "message": "must not be greater than 5" }]
}
```

- **Decide behaviour from `code`**, never from `title` or `detail`. The text can change; codes are stable.
- **`detail`** is safe to show to the user. **`errors[]`** is present for validation problems: show each message next to its field.
- **`requestId`** is also in the `X-Request-Id` response header on every response, successful or not. When something unexpected happens (`INTERNAL_ERROR`), show it so the user can quote it to support.
- Another business's data always answers `NOT_FOUND`, never `FORBIDDEN`, so existence is never revealed.
- Send your own `X-Request-Id` (8-64 letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`) if you want one id to follow a user action across app and server.

| Code | HTTP | Title | What the app should do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | 400 | Bad request | Show a generic "something is wrong with this request" message. |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | Some fields are invalid | Show each entry of `errors[]` next to its field. |
| `FILE_INVALID_KEY` | 400 | Invalid file reference | Programming error; report it. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | 401 | Sign in required | Try one token refresh, then send the user to the login screen. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | Not allowed | Show "you do not have permission"; hide or disable the action. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Not found | Show "not found". Also returned when the item belongs to another business. |
| `FILE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | File not found | Show a placeholder image or "file missing". |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | 405 | Method not allowed | Programming error; report it. |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | Conflict with existing data | Show "already exists" or ask the user to reload and retry. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 409 | Idempotency key reused with different data | Programming error; generate a new key per new bill. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | Request too large | Ask the user to send a smaller file or request. |
| `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | The file is too large | Show the size limit and ask for a smaller file. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | 415 | Unsupported file type | Ask the user to choose a supported file type. |
| `FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED` | 415 | This file type is not allowed | List the allowed types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, CSV. |
| `BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION` | 422 | Not allowed by business rules | Show `detail` to the user. |
| `FILE_EMPTY` | 422 | The file is empty | Ask the user to choose another file. |
| `FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH` | 422 | The file does not match its type | Ask the user to choose a genuine file. |
| `DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_LIMIT` | 422 | Discount exceeds your limit | Offer "ask a manager for approval". |
| `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | 422 | Manager approval required | Open the approval dialog (PIN or remote approval). |
| `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK` | 422 | Not enough stock | Show available quantity for the item. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Too many requests | Wait for the `Retry-After` header, then retry. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Something went wrong | Show "something went wrong" with the `requestId` so the user can quote it to support. |
| `NOT_READY` | 503 | Service not ready | Retry shortly; show a maintenance banner if it persists. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | Service temporarily unavailable | Retry with backoff. |
